html:
GPT-6 does real2sim end to end from robot demonstrations.

I gave it only multi-view RGB and robot actions, and one simple prompt.

It calibrated the cameras, built the object assets, performed physics system-ID, ran MuJoCo, and rendered in Blender. pic.twitter.com/xDlOCXSQzT

— lingxiao guo (@Lingxiao234) September 7, 2026
